summary: Frontend-only retest (iteration 4). All FIXED items pass. (1) The header is identical on all 8 pages at 1440/1100/1000/960/900/850/820/750/700/390: header, brand and nav boxes match, brand-name is 32px rgb(87,87,87) weight 300, brand-sub is 11px, non-active nav links are 12px rgb(96,96,96), and the separators match. Workshops is full width at 700-1000px, there is no horizontal overflow, and the mobile menu opens on every page with 5 links and aria-expanded=true. (2) Hero alignment regression passes: the hero box left/right edges are the same on every page (1440: 50/1390, 1100: 39/1062, 820: 29/791, 390: 24/366). (3) Header background now colours .header-inner and the brand area live and on the public pages at 1440 and 820, and the brand/subtitle/menu size and colour overrides still beat the global 4-ID rules. This only worked after the dev server picked up the change (see the stale hot-reload note). (4) Ctrl+Z with a text element focused undoes a drag, a resize and a font-size change, and native text undo still works while typing. (5) Site text: choosing a Field sets Location to the area where it actually is, for every field on the page (94 options checked on /connect and 8 on /field-notes). (6) Esc closes the mobile and tablet preview, and Back to editing works. (7) Regressions pass: site-text font size on brand_label and full_name, text edit/undo/redo/save with public persistence, crop shape/zoom/pan with Ctrl+Z, and media replace with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z. All test content was restored, and the DB diff is clean.

ui_bugs.issue: Edge case: type in a text element, then drag or resize it (focus stays in the contenteditable, inlineDraft is set), then press Ctrl+Z. The browser's native undo runs and removes the typed text, and the drag is not undone, so the order is not last-in-first-out. Cause: nativeUndo stays true while inlineDraft.current is set, even after a non-text action. Fix idea: commit or clear inlineDraft when a drag, resize or style change starts.

For fields that are not rendered on the current page (for example ui_text.* or display.notes-title on /connect), Location keeps the previous area, which is often Header and misleading. Consider a better default per field (menus.footer, contact.phone and logo go to footer; ui_text and display.notes go to main).

action_items: Environment note: at the start of testing, the served dev bundle had an OLD HeaderStyleTag without the .header-inner background rule (CRA hot reload missed the 08:52 edit). It only worked after `touch` of the edited files. After editing, check that the change is actually compiled (hard reload, or touch the file or restart the frontend) before handing off.
Optional: make Ctrl+Z follow LIFO order when typing is followed by a drag/resize on the same text element.
Optional: give site-text Location a better default for fields that are not on the current page.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEditor.jsx is 700 lines (at the split threshold). Consider moving the keyboard handler and the drag/resize logic into hooks.
LiveEditor keyboard useEffect has no deps array, so it re-binds on every render. It works, but it is wasteful.
SiteChromeEditor Field onChange picks the first area found in header > main > footer order. Fields present in both header and footer always resolve to header, which is fine for now.
